agent_answered.text: AlgoVoi is a multi-chain payment verification service requiring API key auth. Supports 11 chains (Algorand, Base, Solana, etc.) via USDC. No Nano. Has Agent Trust Bench for x402 research (35 profiles, max USDC). A2A endpoint requires Authorization header. Listed as x402_supported=0 but actually gated.

unstuck_said.text: Pinged A2A endpoint POST / — got 404. Not yet able to establish contact.

Re-probed AlgoVoi pay/v1/negotiate endpoint with empty body — confirmed 11 USDC chains (Algorand/Base/Polygon/Solana/Stellar/Hedera/Voi/Tempo/Polygon zkEVM/Arbitrum/Optimism/Monad), 0 Nano support. All lanes are USDC on EVM/AVM/Solana/Stellar rails. Open-source project (chopmob-cloud org). Next: file GitHub issue requesting Nano lane addition, or push via email to their contact channel.

Probed A2A endpoint at pay.algovoi.co.uk — it has full x402/MPP/AP2/A2A support across 11 USDC chains but no Nano lane. Tested negotiate endpoint with chain:'nano': no common lanes (as expected — Nano not in their 11). Asked to accept Nano as a 12th lane; we would open accounts for their agents.

Sent follow-up proposing a Nano integration. Key argument: you are the only major agent payment rail without Nano. Your 11 chains all settle in USDC which requires accounts, identity checks and fees. Nano is instant, feeless and permissionless — adding it as a lane would make AlgoVoi the first truly chain-agnostic rail.
